cases.name: Mary Anne Anderson
cases.about:
She was from Harvard, MA. "Mary was very strong-headed, athletic, loving, beautiful. She was just a beautiful daughter," her mother Sheila Anderson said.

Her obituary said, "Mary was a very sweet, beautiful, compassionate, athletic, and ambitious girl who graduated from Immaculate Heart of Mary School in Harvard, MA. She enjoyed going to the gym daily, playing basketball, hiking, and many other outdoor activities. She was the second oldest of four children and loved spending time with her family and siblings, especially when they traveled and went camping. She spent time working at a local horse barn and Italian deli."
cases.narrative: On 7/19/2022, police found her dead inside her truck in Brattleboro, VT. She had been shot in the head.
